steps.caption: Grok Bot adds a connector by URL
Streamable HTTP, no key for the free studio

probes.name: the studio connector answers an anonymous initialize

posts.text: Grok Bot can now make 3D models. Add three.ws as a connector in Grok Bot, paste one URL, and ask for a chair, a character or a prop. The studio server needs no account and no key, and every reply comes back with a viewer link you can open or embed. We run a probe against production that connects the way xAI's cloud does, so a handshake problem shows up here before it shows up in your chat.
Setup is under Connectors, then custom, with transport Streamable HTTP. The full connector reference, auth modes and rate limits are at three.ws/grok
